svg.title: How tray assignment reads and writes PlanContext
svg.desc: Today AssignTrays writes ctx throughout its loop. Proposed: Solve reads an Input, returns a Result, and ApplyTrayAssignment writes ctx once.

g.text: How tray assignment reads and writes PlanContext

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Same work, different place for the writes. (1) Plan builds a read-only Input from ctx. (2) Solve returns everything it decided as a Result. (3) ApplyTrayAssignment writes it into ctx in one step.
